title: Texan-Style Smothered Haloumi
subtitle: with Potato Wedges and Apple Salad
description: Craving a dinner that’s delightfully delish and easy to get on the table? We’re on a mission to make cooking more fun, extra yum and even simpler – this recipe, packed with quality fresh ingredients, is all that and more. Get cooking!

steps.text: Roast potato wedges: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Cut the unpeeled potatoes into 1.5cm-thick wedges. Combine ½ tsp barbecue seasoning and 2 tsp olive oil in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the potato and toss to coat. Put on the lined tray and roast for 20-25 mins until golden and tender.
Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, thinly slice the cabbage with a sharp knife or mandoline. Thinly slice half the onion, then finely chop the remaining onion. Cut the haloumi in half horizontally.

Cook haloumi and onion: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the haloumi for 2 mins each side or until golden. Remove from the pan. Heat 2 tsp olive oil in the same pan over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and cook, stirring occasionally, for 3 mins or until softened.

Simmer onion sauce: Add the remaining barbecue seasoning and 2 tsp plain flour to the onion and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 min. Add 180ml (¾ cup) water and 2 tbs milk and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, for 4-5 mins until slightly reduced. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Serve up: Meanwhile, cut the apple into matchsticks (see Kitchen hack). Put the apple, cabbage, chopped onion and 2 tsp white wine vinegar in a bowl, season with salt and pepper and toss to combine. Divide the haloumi, potato wedges and apple salad among plates. Pour the onion sauce over the haloumi and enjoy!
Kitchen hack: Here's an easy way to cut an apple into matchsticks: quarter the apple, remove the core, then thinly slice. Stack the slices and cut into matchsticks.
